title: TaskBoard durable workflow, action and native-intent contracts

ExecutionRequirement.description: Select one exact AgentManager host, or automatic for any ready host. Use null in task fields to inherit the TaskBoard default.

WorkspaceRequirement.description: task_workspace allocates an internal workspace; directory_path uses any existing absolute host directory; existing_project selects a known project, optionally with a managed worktree; repository_path checks out a repository URL; new_project_path creates a new project folder.

control.description: user means manual work; agent lets TaskBoard schedule and resume native agent work.

priority.description: Scheduling priority: 4 is highest and 0 is lowest.

executionRequirement.description: Required field. null inherits TaskBoard defaults; automatic selects any eligible PC; host restricts scheduling to that PC.

workspaceRequirement.description: Required workspace policy for this task. Choose one kind deliberately; TaskBoard resolves it on the selected host before starting agent work.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capability keys the selected host must advertise before agent work starts. Missing means none.

userContact.description: Contact route: ticket records only in the ticket; chat also contacts Main; phone also contacts by voice. Omit on root creation to inherit task_configuration defaults.userContact; delegated creation defaults to ticket and delivers completion to the parent. Omit on edit to preserve the setting.

parentTaskId.description: When delegating part of your current task, identify that task as the parent. It owns result review, Done and archival. Omitted userContact defaults to ticket for delegated tasks.

workflowState.description: Initial workflow state; omitted means todo. Agent in_progress requires a real scheduler claim and cannot be created directly. Review requires an initial manual final Result.

initialResult.description: Manual final material for a user-controlled review or done task. Required for review; does not claim native execution.

parentTaskId.description: Assign or remove the delegating parent. Omit to preserve the current parent.

agentDelivery.description: For a user comment on an agent-controlled task, queue asks TaskBoard to start or resume agent work; none records the comment without scheduling it. Omitted means queue. Worker comments use the task userContact route instead.

sourceTaskId.description: For a directed agent message, identify the different sending task and explicitly set authorKind=agent and agentDelivery=queue. Ordinary worker updates never wake themselves.

authorKind.description: Use agent for worker-authored comments; these never enqueue their own execution.

purpose.description: Use question when waiting for user input and handoff for the final delivery. TaskBoard owns the transition after the turn ends.

contactUser.description: Request contact through the configured Main or voice route for an important question. Routine updates stay in the ticket. Completion contact is automatic.

moveToTodo.description: Explicitly reopen a Done task with this comment. Otherwise new comments are processed without reopening task work.

handoff.description: Required for a worker handoff. Declare whether the overall task is ready for review or remains waiting. Applied only after confirmed native completion.

resolvesQuestions.description: Explicitly resolve these ordinary ticket questions with the explanation in body. Native inputs must be answered at their owner.

comments.description: Defaults to the latest 50 comments, newest first. Use before=commentPage.nextBefore to read older messages without gaps when new messages arrive. null nextBefore ends the history. questionsOnly selects unresolved questions; offset retains ascending positional reads.

parentTaskId.description: List unarchived tasks delegated by this parent task, including separate worktrees and hosts.

relatedTo.description: Find other allocated tasks sharing this task canonical working directory and host. Separate worktrees do not match. Read peer tickets before coordinating.
